translated_title: Pemex Cuts Debt by More Than US$20 Billion and Raises Refining 81% Compared to 2018, Carpio Says
original_title: Pemex reduce deuda en más de 20 mil mdd y eleva refinación 81% frente a 2018: Carpio
author: Fernanda Monroy
meta_description: The oil company says its own refineries now supply 87 of every 100 liters it sells, up from 24 in 2018, and plans 1.8 trillion pesos of investment through 2030.
